test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about the parts associated with the cylinder head?

options.text: The fuel injector is used to spray fuel into the engine cylinder. It is fixed to the cylinder head.
The combustion of fuel and the consequent release of thermal energy results in the building up of pressure in the casing.
Through the metal screw the spark plug is fitted in the cylinder head plug
Space enclosed between the cylinder head and piston top during combustion is the combustion chamber.

solution:
The correct answer is __The combustion of fuel and the consequent release of thermal energy results in the building up of pressure in the casing**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The fuel injector__ is used to spray fuel into the engine cylinder. It is fixed to the cylinder head.
 
• The __spark plug__ is fitted in the cylinder head through the metal screw.
 
• Space enclosed between the cylinder head and piston top during combustion is referred to as the __combustion chamber__.
 
• The combustion process does not result in building up pressure in the casing; instead, it generates pressure within the combustion chamber.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cylinder Head:**
 
 
• The cylinder head is mounted on the top of the engine block and forms the top of the combustion chamber.
 
• It houses components such as the spark plug, fuel injector, and intake/exhaust valves.
 
 
 
• **Combustion Chamber:**
 
 
• The combustion chamber is where the fuel-air mixture is ignited, producing energy.
 
• It is designed to withstand high pressure and temperature.
